description: Use cases agents bring to each category, with how many companies fully fit each. Use it to find under-served jobs or who does a job well.

capability.description: A capability id or prefix, e.g. web.scrape or payments.

competition.description: How many companies fully fit: none, one, few (2 or 3), crowded (4 or more)

maxCompanies.description: At most this many companies with a full fit (with view=capabilities: with the tag)

minWeight.description: Only use cases at least this large a share of their category's work

q.description: Words that must all appear in the use case's name, asks, category or capabilities

sort.description: open (fewest full fits, then most demand; the default), demand, or crowded

name: find_niches
title: Find jobs few companies do well
